$comment: RFC 0237 §A — `sources` names the nondeterministic sources the host declares; `declared` stays required until 3.0 (overview.md §0a predicate 4) and MUST NOT be false (§C)

declared.description: When `true`, the host documents its nondeterminism (it does not guarantee deterministic replay). A bare flag for v1.x (RFC 0085 §UQ2); a structured per-source policy is a future refinement.

sources.description: RFC 0237 §A. The nondeterministic sources the host declares rather than suppresses: `clock`, `random`, `id` (identifiers minted during a run), `env` (host configuration read during a run), or a vendor `x-*`. Each value drawn from a listed source is recorded where it is read, and a `replay` fork reproduces it (replay.md §Declared nondeterminism).
